metadata.short_desc: Bilibili comment monitoring, account self-diagnosis, trending topics, lottery filtering
metadata.desc: AstrBot plugin edition of FishTool. The engine runs as a separate process; the console lives in the plugin view.

autostart.description: Start the engine when the plugin is enabled

python.hint: Empty = create an isolated venv from AstrBot's interpreter. Must be Python 3.11 or 3.12.

block_api_key_write.description: Block Open API Key callers from write and credential endpoints

allow_proxy_report.description: Allow AI bot patrol to submit reports on your behalf

enable.hint: When off, /fishtool subcommands stop replying and alert push stops. AstrBot's auto-generated help for a bare /fishtool still shows.

restricted_scope.hint: Controls /fishtool 告警 and /fishtool 监控 状态. Monitoring, monitor on/off, subscribe and self-diagnosis are always admin-only (AstrBot admins_id).

cooldown_seconds.hint: Minimum interval for the same command in the same session; 0 disables it. Admins are exempt.

notify_merge_seconds.hint: Alerts within the window are sent as one forwarded message to reduce rate-limit risk on personal QQ accounts.

report_font_cjk.hint: Absolute path to a .ttf or .ttc (TrueType outlines) on the AstrBot host/container. Noto Sans CJK / Source Han Sans .otf files cannot be used. Empty = auto-detect system fonts; if none is found the PDF falls back to STSong and the layout degrades.

report_font_latin.description: Self-diagnosis report font (digits and Latin, optional)
report_font_latin.hint: Used for cover English, page numbers and UID. Empty = use the CJK font; Bahnschrift is used automatically on Windows.

report_charts.description: Include charts in the self-diagnosis report
report_charts.hint: When off, the PDF contains text and tables only.
